patch.role: Removes NUL bytes; none of the declared inputs contain one.
Decodes an ampersand entity; the declared inputs contain only '<'.
Removes carriage returns; the declared inputs are LF-only.

inputs.mask_two_lt: two '<' characters: both limbs must run
inputs.expose_three_lt: three '<' characters: two limbs cannot cover all
inputs.control_plain: no '<' at all: the enclosing guard never fires

rationale: A escapes every '<' in character data. The patch offers two one-shot escape legs: with exactly two '<' both legs are required to reproduce A (MSMS is the pair), while a string with three '<' is exposed because two one-shot legs leave one raw character.

challenge.note: Only the candidate universe grows. A, the original U blocks and the declared inputs are unchanged, so every correct relation is unchanged; the added candidates are irrelevant on every declared input.
